title: Maths from zero: little numbers, big ideas
description: Start with a few counters. Learn to add, take away and make equal groups through three short lessons you can play with at your own pace.
introduction:
Maths starts with things you can see and count. Bring a few buttons or just use the activities here. We’ll join little piles, take some away, and find out why equal groups are so useful.

There is no clock to beat. Try an idea, change something, and see what happens. These three chapters are your first steps; bigger numbers and fractions can come later.
prerequisites: No arithmetic background. Start by counting the counters one at a time.
outcomes: Model addition with two small piles.
Model subtraction and check it by adding.

lessons.objective: Join two piles and discover what the plus sign means.
Remove counters and check what is left.
Build groups and explore a times table by touch or hover.

glossary.definition: Put amounts together to find a total.
Find what remains when an amount is taken away.
Groups that each contain the same amount.
The number we use for none.
